messages:
Mira (Product): Quick synthesis from the all-hands Q&A
Mira (Product): Folks asked for three concrete clarifications: 1) how we balance investments across Hosted/Dedicated/Private this FY, 2) a one-liner sales trigger for Dedicated outreach, 3) a compact competitor positioning line we can use in decks.

Jordan (CEO): Short answers: keep mission steady  make inference predictable and cost-effective for engineers. Investment posture: prioritize Hosted for growth and velocity, couple Dedicated workstreams for monetization & SLAs, and keep Private as a resource-light strategic track. All get funding but hiring skews to Hosted.

Lucas (Eng): For planning: does Hosted-first mean Dedicated feature rollouts get delayed indefinitely or just lower priority? Need to lock sprint commitments.

Jordan (CEO): Lower priority, not frozen. Preserve Dedicated stability and critical enterprise features. New major UX or infra work will be staggered; Hosted gets faster iteration cycles.

Priya (Sales): Need a crisp trigger: what should SDRs/AMs watch for to pitch Dedicated?

Jordan (CEO): Working trigger: sustained monthly bill > $40k OR repeated peak QPS beyond shared pool capacity OR explicit compliance request. RevOps to set final numbers. Use $40k as a placeholder for playbook drafts.

Sam (RevOps): We'll validate thresholds against historical usage and churn signals and confirm next week.

Mira (Product): Competitor blurb request: want something short, neutral, and factual for slides.

Jordan (CEO): Use: "Redwood gives you a single inference runtime across hosted, reserved, and private deployments so teams get consistent latency, transparent unit economics, and production-grade controls without rebuilding ops." Tailor tone for dev vs exec.

Lucas (Eng): Operational note: if we roll batching or caching improvements in Hosted, how do we avoid surprising Dedicated/Private users?

Mira (Product): Rule: runtime optimizations that change observable behavior need documented opt-ins for Dedicated/Private and a two-week heads-up. Eng to draft compatibility policy.

Priya (Sales): I'll add Jordan's one-liner and the $40k placeholder to the sales playbook and flag it as provisional.

Sam (RevOps): I'll run the threshold analysis and post a recommendation by Friday.

MeetingBot: Recording + notes uploaded: https://redwood.internal/recordings/2365311122 and shared drive doc.

Mira (Product): Thanks all  dropping follow-ups here is perfect.
